title: PCR Protocol
author: 宏亮 董

materials: Program the thermocycler as follows: 98℃ 5 min 98℃ 15 s Tm-4℃ 15 s 72℃ （5-10s）× (1 kb) 72℃ 5 min 4℃ forever

steps.title: Prepare Reagents on Ice
steps.instruction: Place the DNA template and 2×high Taq Master Mix in a small box with ice prior to using the Bio-rad S1000TM Thermo Cycler.

steps.title: Assemble PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents to a PCR tube to reach a total volume of 50 μl:

substeps.instruction: Add 25 μl of 2×high Taq Master Mix (Enzyme)
Add 2 μl of Forward Primer (10 μM)
Add 2 μl of Reverse Primer (10 μM)
